item.title: Shortcodes
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Introducing Shortcode Engine "Archon"

[props width='1060' height='450' ][prop left='160' top='10' delay='0' image='http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/imac-shortcode.png' effect='big-fade-left' ][/prop][prop left='520' top='160' delay='500' image='http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-ipad.png' effect='big-fade-left' ][/prop][prop left='680' top='233' delay='800' image='http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-ipad-hor.png' effect='big-fade-right' ][/prop][/props]
  [counter start="0" end="45" effect_type="fade" speed="60" increment="1" color="#ffffff" background="#05ccca" /]
[power_title color="#889998" ]Over 45 Amazing Shortcodes[/power_title] Limitless covers all important widgets needed to make an amazing site. Whether you need buttons or pricing tables or tabs, We have got it covered. An array of graphs , charts and progressive elements are available to show data on your site. Linked to our Query engine , post / portfolio shortcodes gives you complete control and flexibility of which posts you want to show.
  • UI Items such as buttons , notifications , dividers and many more.
  • Widgets such as tabs, accordion , pricing tables and many more.
  • Graphs and Charts such as Pie , Bar and line.
  • Social elements such has twitter tweets , icons and team widget.
  • Wordpress widgets such as posts slider, lists and grids.
    [power_title color="#647070" ]No Need to remember any shortcode.[/power_title] With Archon, all your shortcodes are at one place and you don't need to remember any shortcode or options. Even the documentation is one click away. Archon provides an Interface to add any input with allowable options, giving you complete control of the shortcodes. Not only that all shortcode are logical divided in sections with can be accessed with ease.
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win14.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win21.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]
    [power_title color="#647070" ]Visual Column Builder.[/power_title] With Archon, you have a column builder with it can you create columns on the fly. Not only that , it supports nested columns, so virtually any column layout is possible. With this a column shortcode is provided which can be used to insert columns in existing contnet.
    [power_title color="#647070" ]Documentation Free Shortcodes.[/power_title] You never have to worry about how shortcodes work , Archon provides extremely easy to use interface which gives you complete control. It will give you all the options the shortcode can provide.
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win3.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win4.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]
    [power_title color="#647070" ]Complexity Made Simplicity.[/power_title] Add widgets in a breeze, Archon provides extremely easy way to add complex widgets. You can easily add multiple sections of a widget , sort theme and delete them. No need to cut / copy the code.
    [power_title color="#647070" ]Amazing Charts & Progress Elements.[/power_title] Limitless provides all major graph and chart types to suit your needs. Not only that progress elements such as progress bars , stacked circles and counters are provided. You can literally show any type of data set. No need to worry about adding new plugin or code.
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win5.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]
[image src="http://localhost/limitless/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/shortcode-win6.png" resize="false" frame="none" align="none" width="564" height=250 link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-top" /]

item.title: Buttons
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[power_title color="#222" ]Tale of a Button[/power_title] Using Limitless shortcode Engine Archon you get create almost any type of button within within seconds. You can set roundness of a button ... [button size="small" color="#ffffff" background="#0bd60b" radius="0px" type="gradient" link="http://" newwindow="false" icon="" ]Button[/button] ... [button size="small" color="#ffffff" background="#0bd60b" radius="5px" type="gradient" link="http://" newwindow="false" icon="" ]Button[/button] ... [button size="small" color="#ffffff" background="#0bd60b" radius="10px" type="gradient" link="http://" newwindow="false" icon="" ]Button[/button] ... [button size="small" color="#ffffff" background="#0bd60b" radius="20px" type="gradient" link="http://" newwindow="false" icon="" ]Button[/button] you can set the size of a button [button size="small" color="#045f67" background="#19d3e4" radius="2px" type="gradient" link="http://" newwindow="false" icon="" ]Button[/button] ... item.title: Home
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Page Builder Content

Extended Options

Important settings placed in one location
Xinity has a whole new range of radical features that will improve your workflow many folds.

Header Constructor

Create amazing top area layouts.
We've build a amazing drag and drop builder that allows you to create virtually any top layout

Live Front-end Editor

Fast front-end building experience.
Start editing your content straight from the front-end with our new and super fast front-end editor

RAD Builder

Revolutionary Live Drag and Drop Editor
RAD Builder takes editing to a new level. Create amazing pages with complete control.

CRAFT AMAZING WEBSITES AT MIND BLOWING SPEED. SIMPLE, MINIMAL OR COMPLEX, LIMITLESS DOES THE JOB!

Top Notch Support

WPML Compatible

Woocommerce Ready

Create advanced portfolios from withing our page builder, use filter, change font sizes, color and much much more options available.

LATEST WORK

Showing 8 portfolio items in 4-col format.
Easy to manage, easy to maintain and the best part of it all is that your up and running within minutes.

RAPID INSTALLATION

RADICAL FEATURES

Limitless offers a whole new range of radical features that will improve your workflow many folds. You will experience a whole new level of power with complete control and extremely easy to use UI .
  •  Advanced Option Panel
  •  40+ shortcodes with Shortcode Builder
  •  Title Area Manager with Gradients Support !
  •  Select fonts per post/page
  •  Woocommerce
  • WPML Compatible
  • And much much more

FLEXIBLE GALLERIES

Built on top of Wordpress Media system , our Media manager allows you to create media widgets quickly. You can add multiple images at once and sort them the way you link.

Powerful

FONT MANAGER

Google Fonts

500+ Fonts at your service
Google fonts is seamlessly integrated into limitless. You can set Menu, Body and Title fonts separately. On top of that in each page/post or custom post your able to add fonts for title and subtitle.

Font Face Support

Use any font you like
We have integrated font face into limitless, you can effortlessly use font face without touching any code. All you need to do is load the font into limitles folder and tell where to use the font . That’s it

Font Deck

Takes you even further
We've gone an extra mile to provide you Font Deck support, you can easily use font deck’s fonts by adding them inside the setting details. No need to worry about code etc. It works flawlessly with limitless. Add your font ID that’s it.

YOU'VE BEEN AWESOMIZED ALREADY? THEN DON'T HESITATE AND BUY THIS AWESOME THEME NOW!

Still not convinced, we've got plenty more features lined up for you.

MORE FEATURES

Super Responsive Menu

2 Types of Responsive Menu
We have worked exceptionally hard on our responsive menu to provide you an amazing mobile experience. Choose between the traditional menu dropdown style or new generation slide-able menu system.

Hyper Menu

Powerful , Amazing and Flexible
With our hyper menu you can create mega menus, smooth sub menus in a flash. 10 options are provided for menu animation and the effects are css3 optimized and degrades gracefully.

Color Dominant Mode

Choose Color per Menu Item
Our menu system provides a unique approach. It gives you the ability to set background color for each menu item, that includes the sub menu items too. Now you can highlight pages from the menu directly.

Page Speed

Google Page Speed Integrated

[image src="http://demo1.artillegence.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2014/02/photodune-3151195-interior-of-an-empty-warehouse-s.jpg" resize="hproportional" lightbox="true" frame="none" align="none" width="520" height="450" link="" hoverbg="#ffffff" hoverc="#00d0bf" effect="fade-bottom" /] Quality over Quantity has been our mantra since our inception. We have always aimed to give our customers the latest , mind blowing and pixel perfect applications. We are not certainly the cheapest in the field , but we take your business as our own and will give 200% in it.  The applications will be not only server as your website but will help you to increase your profits.

Inception

We first discuss with you, your end goal and needs. Then we propose few ideas. Based on mutual agreement we take the first step.

Development

We develop application at our pace and once it is in alpha stage, we show it to you. Any feedback is taken into account and changes are made.

Deploy

We launch the application on client's end and help the staff with working of the application. We make sure that they are comfortable and happy.

Good Karma

We are strong believers of good karma , once the project has been handed over the client. We maintain good relationships with them.

item.title: RAD Builder
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded: [power_title color="#13c4c4" ]Introducing RAD Builder[/power_title] [video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72519618[/video] Revolution in content editing. RAD Builder is one of it's kind, the first front end Drag n Drop builder. Not only that it comes with in builder styler that allows you to style each component individually. No need to add widgets in backend and refresh in front end. With RAD builder you see what you are making and gives you speed upto 10 times over traditional backend builders. 26 Amazing Components from Layout elements to widgets to graph elements, we have got you covered. Not only that RAD Builder provides you powerful post / portfolio components which can help you to show virtually any combination of post. [image_wrapper texture='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg' src='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/rad0.jpg'] The most powerful text component you have seen, It can perform any thing you want. Build in with a powerful editor with integrated shortcode button. You will be amazed how easy it is, to create mind blowing content. [image_wrapper texture='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg' src='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/rad11.jpg'] RAD builder is seamlessly connected to our Query Engine which allows you to show any variation of posts. Not only that all major layouts come inbuilt in Posts Component. The feature list does not end there, you can also animate each element. [image_wrapper texture='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg' src='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/rad21.jpg'] With RAD builder you get amazing graph elements which can be used to show information is an amazing way. All major charts and graph are at your finger tips , with an extremely easy to use interface. [image_wrapper texture='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg' src='http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/rad31.jpg'] Not only that you get amazing widgets like tabs  , accordion , galleries and much more.

item.title: Header Constructor
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded: [video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72544264[/video] Build Head Area faster and with more control than ever before. With Header constructor you can just drag and drop components and create virtually any layouts possible. 3 Header areas and you can show or hide each one. On top of that you can adjust margins and alignment as well. Imagination is the limit with this amazing one of a kind builder. [image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/header11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg" /]

item.title: Hyper Menu
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless comes with hyper menu , power menu system from which you can literally make any menu structure possible. Select from 10 menu effects and set color for each menu item. It offers you amazing functionality.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/hypermenu1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/hypermenu11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Ajax Search
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
We have taken search to a new level and created an amazing search system for you. The Ajax search displays live search in an elegant with an option to view the search results on the search page.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/ajaxsearch1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Shortcode Builder
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded: [video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72606822[/video] Introducing our shortcode builder Archon , next revolution in using shortcodes. Archon shortcode builder provides an amazing experience when working with shortcodes.  No longer need to search for documentation on how shortcode works or what are it's options, Archon does it for you. [image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/archon11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]   [image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/archon2.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]   [image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/archon3.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Admin Interface
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless provides an amazing admin interface that contains all the panels at one place giving you a better experience. All important settings are placed in one place "Theme Admin" , which also can be directly accessed from WP admin dashboard.
[image_wrapper texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg" src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/adminpanel1.jpg" /]

item.title: Media Manager
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72673922[/video]
Media Manager let's you create awesome galleries and slide shows in matter of minutes. You can add multiple images in a single click. Loaded with tons of options, it is one of the most exciting features of Limitless.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/mediamanager1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Content Type Maker
item.dc:creator: lucifer

item.title: Flexi Templates
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72525766[/video]
With flexi templates you are no longer bounded with portfolio word for portfolio custom types, change it the way you want and you wont have to touch any code and all templates will work flawlessly
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/flexi1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Localization
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless is compatible with WPML plugin and not only that a PO file is also provided to give our users maximum localization support. RTL support has also been provided for our users also.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/wpml.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Sticky Sidebars
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
We have not limited to simple sidebar layouts but expanded more to give you sticky sidebars support. It is perfect when you have a long page and a sidebar widget like menu to be always visible.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/sticky1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/sticky11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Responsive Design
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Powered by our Poseidon Responsive Framework , Limitless gives you an amazing experience. The layout is optimized to show off your content. Each button is designed to give highest experience experience possible. Like your sidebar is 1 click away on tables and mobiles. Not only that 2 types of awesome mobile menus are provided.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/res.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/res2.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: IOA Installer
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72391275[/video]
Limitless comes with the most advanced IOA installer that let's you setup sites in matter of minutes. Not only that you can select what type of website you want to create and it will pre populate the pages and settings for you.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/installer.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Title Area Manager
item.dc:creator: lucifer

item.title: Font Manager
item.dc:creator: lucifer

item.title: Font Icons
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless comes with over 500 icons , it will suit all your needs. The icons are also retina ready. Plus with our icon engine you can change icon color and size in a breeze.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/fonticons.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Under Construction Mode
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless contains a flexible Under Construction mode which can be used in site changes and you don't need an extra plugin.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/underconstructor.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/underconstructor1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Enigma Styler
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72525764[/video]
With Enigma you can create change stylings without touching any css file. See what you style with this amazing visual styler.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/enigma.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Portfolio Filters
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72591232[/video]
We have an extensive portfolio filter panel that allows you to have complete control of which portfolio items you want for each portfolio template. Seamlessly linked to our Query maker you can set any combination you want to show. You can control post items limit , content limit , hover type and thumbnails image resizing.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/portfoliofilter1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/portfoliofilter11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Blog Filters
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
[video width="740" height="500" ]https://vimeo.com/72525763[/video]
With our blog filters, you get absolute control of what type of posts you want to show. It is seamlessly integrated with our Query Maker that gives you an unbelievable control over which posts you want to show . You will be amazed how easy and powerful it is.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/blogfilters1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/blogfilters11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Super Dashboard
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless provides you with a unqiue feature, we have integrated some important widgets into the WP Admin dasboard. This includes a home page speed checked , link to important places such has admin interface and RAD builder.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/superdashboard1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: 8 Blog Templates
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless provides you with 8 amazing blog templates to show your posts in an mind blowing way. Coupled with blog filters you can create any blog in any way you like. From classic blog to timeline to full width blogs we have covered everything for you.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/portfoliotemplates1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: 12 Portfolio Templates
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Your complete portfolio solution is here. With Limitless you get 12 types of portfolio templates. From classic portfolio columns to full screen galleries to slideable images to new concepts such as Maeyra template. Everything you need is packed into limitless. On top of that, it works on our flexi templating engine which allows you to behave them in any way you like like products , galleries etc.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/portfoliotemplates1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: Quick Tour
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
With our quick tour feature you will never feel lost. Just click on it and it will guide you through all features of limitless. No need to check documentation.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/quickhelp1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
 
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/quickhelp11.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: SEO Optimized
item.dc:creator: lucifer

item.title: Dominant Color Mode
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Each project is unique and same touch to all projects cannot do justification. For that we have added dominant color for each portfolio and posts. It allows you to specify unique color for each posts and show in highlights.
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/dominantcolors1.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]

item.title: 12 Featured Media Types
item.dc:creator: lucifer
item.content:encoded:
Limitless provides you with 12 featured media types. From featured images to full width sliders to galleries, we have got you covered. You will be amazed at how easy it is to showcase your products now. You can see them in action [button size="medium" color="#ffffff" background="#db0d44" radius="0px" type="flat" link="http://getioa.com/limitless/featured-image-proportional/" newwindow="true" icon="" ]View Here[/button]
[image_wrapper src="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/07/featured.jpg" texture="http://getioa.com/limitless/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2013/08/webtreats_wood-pattern8-512.jpg"]
